L25·N5783unmasked layer
Weak, diffuse neuron with no clear semantic content: it fires modestly on short function/continuation tokens in the middle of a multi-word phrase (notably " the" in "at the end of the day"/"in the Convention Center", clause-initial " I", a list comma, and word-internal pieces like "vascular", "/D"), and is suppressed on prepositions/adverbs closing fixed phrases (" of" in "point of view", " on", " finally", ")").
